messages:
maria-chen: Heads up — I need to land a hotfix to routing fallback before the 11:30 PST deploy freeze. It fixes a regression where fallbacks pick the wrong model variant under burst. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/patch-123

kevin-brown: pinging for approvals and a CI rerun. Which CI job is failing? :eyes:

maria-chen: flaky gpu-integ-7 on xgmi. Fails on the last integration step (see snippet). I pushed a test skip but want to land the actual fix + skip removed in follow-up.

sarah-lee: can you paste the failing log? if it's a known flaky we can rerun and backfill the slot.

maria-chen: log:
```
[ RUN      ] InferenceRoutingTest.LookupVariantUnderLoad
E       AssertionError: expected variant "v1-quant" but got "v1-8bit"
.../serving/routing_manager_test.cc:142
```

emily-wu: @maria-chen can you rebase on main? CI had a kernel rollout yesterday that changed scheduling; rebase might help.

maria-chen: yeah rebased and pushed (force). Rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5543. Still failing same assertion on gpu-integ-7.

pranav-shah: if CI keeps flaking we can do a manual gating approval for this hotfix because it's high risk for prod. Ops, any objections?

deploy-bot: Notice — scheduled deploy freeze starts at 2026-03-17T19:30:00Z. Automatic merges will be blocked unless explicitly allowed by release leads.

kevin-brown: I can give manual approval. Two asks: 1) add a short note in the PR about the revert plan and 2) create a tiny canary flag so we can rollback quickly if needed.

maria-chen: added canary flag and a rollback job in the PR description. Also added the revert checklist. Thanks Kevin.

sarah-lee: +1 from me on the patch itself (code looks good). CI is flaky but logs don't show a functional regression beyond the race we addressed. If Kevin okays, go ahead and merge with manual gating.

kevin-brown: I'm ok with manual merge. @deploy-bot can you hold a manual gate for this PR? Otherwise I'll ask release leads to temporarily open a rebase window.

deploy-bot: Manual gate requested: PR #6572 by maria-chen. Release leads notified. Please include the root-cause link and postmortem follow-up: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/6572

maria-chen: thanks all — I'll land once release lead confirms. Leaving notes on rollback steps and who to call if canary fails. :thumbsup:
